content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Fonts online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack designed to bypass platform restrictions. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store. For font creators, this means hosting your products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, using backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and processing payments through NOWPayments—a crypto gateway with 0.5% fees and no KYC. The key difference? You own the entire stack. No third-party platform can shut you down or hold your funds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and decentralized. Your fonts are hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring fast, global delivery. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which manage order processing and file delivery. Payments are verified on-chain via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each component is independent, so if one fails, the rest continue to function. This design eliminates single points of failure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. Font designers, ebook authors, course creators, and software developers in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe use this stack to sell globally. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. If you’ve ever had a PayPal account suspended or been locked out of Stripe, this is your permanent solution.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on-chain and triggers file delivery automatically. Each component is free or low-cost, and they integrate seamlessly to create a fully functional store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions and integrate it with your backend. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, and upload your font files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test the entire flow end-to-end to ensure payments trigger file delivery. If you prefer a turnkey solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, fully configured and tested.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent alternative. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This stack bypasses platform restrictions entirely, giving you full control over your store and payments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, ready to sell.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
